texts: Rashee Rice's targets went 2, then 6, then 9. The stove's on in Kansas City and he is the top name in this week's usage read. Trade for him before his price catches up. Let's dive in. #ChiefsKingdom

Rising: Rashee Rice, KC WR. Targets 2 to 6 to 9, team highs @MIA. Trade for him; offer a WR3 and a bench RB.
Rising: Josh Downs, IND WR. Targets 3 to 9 to 11 with Alec Pierce on IR. Start him as a WR3. #ChiefsKingdom #ForTheShoe

Rising: Cam Skattebo, NYG RB. Snap share 76 percent, every first-quarter snap, 23 touches. Start him as a RB2.
Rising: Wan'Dale Robinson, TEN WR. Snaps 28 to 38, game-high 11 targets. Claim him, 2 to 5 percent of FAAB. #NYGiants #TitanUp

Left to cool: Omarion Hampton, LAC RB. Snap share 80.6 percent in Week 1, 42 in Week 3, 6 routes. Trade him away.
Marvin Harrison Jr., ARI WR. 9 targets in three games. Sit him until his target share clears 15 percent. #BoltUp #BirdGang

Left to cool: TreVeyon Henderson, NE RB. Snaps went 33 to 23 as Stevenson took the job back. Monitor Sunday's snap split.
Brian Thomas Jr., JAX WR. 1 target in Week 3, 13 on the year. Drop him. #NEPats #DUUUVAL
